name: orbit-app
title: Orbit app dashboard
description: The app behind the Orbit landing page: a shell with sidebar, command palette, notifications and user menu, and 13 screens (overview, invoices, invoice detail and editor, recurring, clients and client detail, payments, reports, settings, sign in, sign up, not found). Wears whichever DressCode theme is installed, in light and dark.
author: DressCode UI <https://dresscodeui.com>

docs:
Orbit app dashboard: the screens are in components/orbit-app/ and the routes are /orbit-app/<screen> (start at /orbit-app/overview).
Sample data lives in components/orbit-app/data.ts; replace it with your own as you wire the screens to your backend.
It reads lib/dresscode-theme.ts, so install a DressCode theme first (any of the nine), e.g. npx shadcn@latest add https://dresscodeui.com/r/dresscode/mono.json
Built on shadcn/ui with Base UI (components.json style base-*): the menus and sheet use Base UI's render prop.
